node.title: Primitive exact-list local general-star budget
node.statement: At an official base row let N=2^41, K=rho N, t=t_XR=min{0<=j<=N-K:q^j>=2^128 binom(N,N-K-j)}, and A=K+t. Fix the same support-wise first-match map as the final LIST ledger. For every primitive residual full locator-prefix fiber F_z^prim and base support S0, S maps injectively to (S\S0,S0\S), a general order-t star-PTE record. Prove |F_z^prim|-1<=16N^3-1 uniformly over official fields and domains. The exact difference-degree partition writes this local degree as D_0+sum_{d>=1}D_d, where d=deg(L_P-L_Q), D_0 is precisely the F-4 minimal constant-shift stratum, and d>=1 implies side width e>=t+d+1. The coefficient-scale quotient sieve removes every common scale c>1 and gives c|gcd(N,e,d); the remaining direct residue is coefficient-primitive. At d=1 the exact local object is a translated complementary-divisor incidence B|L_(S0), B+aX+b|L_(D\S0), and fixed aX+b is not an injective record key. The official corridor gives t>=2^31; either fixed-locator projection codegree is at most 1024, and the complete high-width band e>=N/4+1 costs at most N^3/64. Across all d>=1, every cell with 4e^2>N(e+d) costs at most 5N^3/16 in aggregate. The surviving nonconstant wedge satisfies 4e^2<=N(e+d) and e>=t+d+1; an abstract-code route cut proves its changed-set intersection constraints alone admit more than 16N^3 blocks, so locator algebra or exact first-owner structure is essential. Every live coefficient-primitive pair has a canonical nonzero antipodal fold beta_0. At effective depth T=e-d-1 it satisfies p^ceil(T/2)<=p^(fo)<=|Norm(beta_0)|<=(4e)^(N/4), where f=ord_N(p) and o counts represented Frobenius orbits; higher nonzero dyadic folds give analogous necessary gates. No population bound for vectors passing those gates is yet proved. D_0 and this wedge remain open. Transported quotient rows use their exact compiler-emitted tuple and own allowance and must appear in the final table.
node.falsifier: A consumed official or quotient row with a correctly stripped primitive full-prefix fiber containing more than 16N^3 actual LIST supports at that row's own scale under the declared first-owner map.
